column1: # Claims of concepts-seats-tree.svg in docs/concepts/seats-and-sessions.md.
element
vtium runs on a VT in place of getty
and /bin/login logs you in
the default build: vtium opens the screen and the keyboards itself, on the kernel's VT
the build with libseat and logind asks a seat manager for its devices first
a seat manager answered: the seat is vtium's VT backend
no seat manager answered: vtium opens its devices itself, as the default build does
libseat tries seatd, then logind
default build and direct mode: vtium gives login XDG_SEAT and XDG_VTNR, so pam_systemd or pam_elogind registers your login on seat0
systemd and logind: you choose a mode for each VT
direct mode's unit, vtium@.service
seat mode's unit, vtium-seat@.service
direct mode is the advice
direct mode: vtium never asks logind for its devices, and takes them from seatd where seatd runs
seat mode: systemd opens a PAM session of vtium's own
seat mode: vtium's own session is a greeter's
seat mode: your login gets no seat variables, and none of vtium's session
seat mode: your login runs in a systemd scope of its own, so it gets a session with no seat
seat mode needs the build, the unit, the PAM file and logind's seat0
elogind, the libseat build: as in direct mode, the PAM file holds the seat only if init opens it
